lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p1 - Listen, point and say.

details: Listen, Point and Say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Listening and pointing show accurate sound–image matching, while saying builds early pronunciation accuracy and confidence in counting to 20.
Look for correct pointing, clear repetition of the target words and numbers 1-20, correct intonation and recognisable pronunciation of initial sounds.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p1 - Find, count and write

details: Find, count and write reinforces recognition of numbers up to twenty by having students locate specific items in the scene and record the matching number, supporting quantity awareness and early written accuracy.
Look for correct counting of butterflies, bees and flowers, accurate number writing, consistent matching of quantity to written numbers, and neat bookwork.
